data.name: Execution_StructureHelp
data.value:
Conversations are grouped by workspace. Tasks stay inside the current conversation. Choosing a task or browsing a branch does not change the context that is executing.
Each execution record shows state, action, duration, and time. Select a record to see its command, output, source, and child calls below. Use the menu or right-click to manage records in bulk.
Terminating a conversation writes the server gate first, then cancels pending approvals and running calls. Closing this window only stops observation. It does not stop execution.
Older tasks without steps show that progress was not recorded. Unattributed calls keep their original call IDs and can be exported, isolated, archived, or moved to trash. Permanent deletion does not delete project source files.
Shortcuts: Ctrl+F searches conversations, F5 refreshes, Esc closes details, and Shift+F10 opens the menu for the selected item.
